description: This bar chart, titled “Researcher Location,” illustrates the number of hateful communication datasets published per year from 2012 to 2022, categorized by the geographic location of the researchers involved. The vertical axis, labeled “Number of datasets,” is plotted on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10⁰ (1) to 10² (100), with major gridlines at 1, 10, and 100. The horizontal axis represents the “Year,” spanning from 2012 to 2022. A legend identifies six researcher locations: “Other” (dark blue), “USA” (orange), “IN” (green), “UK” (red), “IT” (purple), and “DE” (brown). Each year features a grouped set of bars corresponding to these locations, with bar heights indicating the count of datasets. Notably, “Other” consistently dominates in later years, peaking at over 100 datasets in 2021. The USA shows moderate activity, particularly in 2016, 2018, 2020, and 2021. India (IN) and the UK (UK) contribute smaller but consistent numbers, especially from 2017 onward. Italy (IT) and Germany (DE) appear intermittently, with IT showing a notable presence in 2017 and 2019, and DE in 2017, 2018, and 2020. The chart reveals a clear upward trend in dataset publication over time, with a significant surge beginning around 2017 and peaking in 2021, primarily driven by researchers categorized as “Other.”
